blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover images degraded by rain, haze, snow, and other weather-induced artifacts, thereby improving the robustness of outdoor vision systems. Existing unified restoration models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenes due to their reliance on synthetic supervision and insufficient semantic constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel student–teacher semi-supervised framework that addresses both challenges. Specifically, we introduce an unreliable database that preserves failed teacher predictions as informative negative samples for contrastive learning, while a reliable database stores high-quality teacher predictions as positive samples. By jointly exploiting reliable pseudo-ground truths and unreliable teacher outputs, the proposed framework learns to enhance desirable restoration characteristics while avoiding common failures. We further propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that replaces computationally expensive text-based supervision with an efficient and naturally aligned semantic prior. An adaptive phase consistency loss is also designed to dynamically balance supervision between the degraded input and teacher pseudo-ground truths according to degradation severity. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in restoration quality and perceptual fidelity while exhibiting stronger generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 不良天气图像修复旨在收复被雨水,雾霾,雪等天气诱发的文物所退化的图像,从而提高室外视觉系统的稳健性. 现有的统一还原模型由于依赖合成监督以及语义约束不足,对现实世界场景的概括性有限. 在本文中,我们提出了一个新颖的学生-教师半监督框架,以应对这两个挑战。 具体来说,我们引入了一个不可靠的数据库,将失败的教师预测保存为信息化的负面样本来进行对比性学习,而可靠的数据库则存储高质量的教师预测为正样本. 通过共同利用可靠的伪地真相和不可靠的教师产出,拟议框架学习增强理想的恢复特性,同时避免常见的失败. 我们进一步建议采用相位频谱语义约束,用高效和自然对齐的前语义取代计算成本高的文本语义监督. 适应性相一致性损失还旨在根据退化的严重程度,动态地平衡对退化输入和教师伪地真理的监督。 对现实世界基准的广泛试验表明,拟议方法在恢复质量和观念忠实方面一贯超过现有最新方法,同时表现出对现实世界不利天气条件的更强有力的概括。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Images captured in real-world environments are often degraded by adverse weather conditions such as rain, haze, and snow, which significantly deteriorate the performance of outdoor vision systems. Existing image restoration methods have mainly focused on task-specific models tailored to individual weather phenomena ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Although these methods achieve strong performance through extensive training in large-scale synthetic datasets, their highly specialized designs limit scalability in diverse weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界环境中捕捉到的图像往往被雨,雾和雪等恶劣的天气条件所退化,这大大地使户外视觉系统的性能恶化. 现有图像还原方法主要以适合个别天气现象的具体任务模型为主(Wang等,2025b.). 虽然这些方法通过大规模合成数据集的广泛培训取得了强效,但是其高度专业化的设计限制了在不同天气条件下的可伸缩性.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, recent studies have proposed unified restoration frameworks capable of handling multiple weather degradations within a single model ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Although these approaches demonstrate promising results on synthetic benchmarks, they exhibit limited generalization to real-world scene. We attribute this to two key factors: their heavy reliance on synthetic supervision and neglect of the semantic context of the scenes, due to insufficient constraints during training.
blocks.zh: 为了消除这一局限性,最近的研究提出了能够在单一模式内处理多起天气退化的统一恢复框架(Wang等,2025a; 吴等,2026). 虽然这些方法在合成基准方面显示出有希望的结果,但它们对现实世界的概括有限。 我们将此归因于两个关键因素:由于训练期间的限制不足,他们严重依赖合成监督,忽视场景的语义背景.

blocks.en: To alleviate the dependency on synthetic data, unsupervised restoration methods have been proposed that require only unpaired real-world images ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . However, these approaches fail to exploit the abundant labeled synthetic datasets that have become widely available. Semi-supervised learning offers a more attractive compromise by leveraging both labeled synthetic and unlabeled real-world data. For example, WResVLM ( Xu et al., 2024 ) adopts a student–teacher framework in which the teacher generates pseudo-ground truths (pseudo-GTs) for unlabeled images. Nevertheless, the framework performs contrastive learning using only positive samples derived from reliable pseudo-ground truths, overlooking informative negative samples that could explicitly guide the student away from poor restoration results. We observe that the teacher frequently produces low-quality predictions during training. These predictions often contain severe artifacts, color distortions, or incomplete restoration (Fig. 6 b), and have previously been simply discarded. However, we note that they are not just generic negative samples, but are in fact sampled directly from the model in an on-policy manner, and hence provide valuable information ( Tang et al., 2024 ) . To address the previous limitation, we propose a mechanism that leverages these informative failures for contrastive semi-supervised learning. More specifically, we retain these cases in an unreliable database and treat them as negative samples for contrastive learning. By simultaneously attracting the student toward reliable restorations while repelling it from unreliable ones, the proposed framework provides stronger supervision and improves generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻对合成数据的依赖,提出了未经监督的修复方法,这些方法只需要未经证实的真实世界的图像(Liu等人,2025a)。 然而,这些方法未能利用已广泛获得的大量标签合成数据集。 半被监督的学习通过利用被标注的合成和无标注的现实世界数据,提供了更有吸引力的妥协. 例如,WResVLM(Xu等,2024年)采用了学生-教师框架,在该框架中,教师为没有标签的图像生成伪地真言(pseudo-GTs). 然而,该框架只利用从可靠的伪地真相中获得的正样本进行对比性学习,忽略了信息性负面样本,这些样本可以明确引导学生远离不良的修复结果. 我们观察到,教师在培训期间经常作出质量低下的预测。 这些预测往往包含严重的文物,色彩扭曲,或者不完全的还原(图6b),而之前只是被简单地抛弃了. 然而,我们注意到,它们不仅仅是一般性的负面样本,事实上是以政策方式直接从模型中取样的,因此提供了宝贵的信息(Tang等人,2024年)。 为了解决之前的限制,我们建议建立一种机制,利用这些信息性失败来进行对比性的半监督学习。 更具体地说,我们把这些病例保存在一个不可靠的数据库中,把它们当作反向学习的负面样本。 通过同时吸引学生走向可靠的修复,同时将其从不可靠的修复中击退,拟议的框架提供了更强有力的监督,并改进了对现实世界恶劣天气条件的概括。

blocks.en: Besides the supervision strategy, effective semantic guidance is equally important for restoring visually plausible images. Recent methods employ large vision-language models (VLMs) to generate textual descriptions that explicitly constrain image semantics ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Although effective, text supervision suffers from two inherent drawbacks. First, textual descriptions are only weakly aligned with the fine-grained spatial structures required for low-level vision tasks because of language ambiguity and the lossy language-vision representation gap ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . Second, generating accurate descriptions with large VLMs introduces substantial computational overhead, slowing the training process.
blocks.zh: 除了监督战略外,有效的语义指导对于恢复视觉上可信的图像同样重要。 近期的方法使用大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)生成文本描述,明确限制图像语义(徐等,2024. 文本监督虽然有效,但存在两个固有的缺陷。 一,文字描述仅与低等视觉任务需要的精细空间结构相弱相通,因为语言模糊和语言-视差缺失(吴等,2024. 第二,用大型VLM制作准确的描述,引入了大量的计算间接费用,使培训进程放慢了速度.

blocks.en: Instead of relying on language supervision, we exploit the Fourier phase spectrum as an efficient structural prior. It is well established that the Fourier phase spectrum primarily preserves structural and semantic information, whereas the amplitude spectrum mainly represents low-level appearance ( Oppenheim et al., 1979 ) . Existing Fourier-based restoration methods ( Guo et al., 2022 ) mainly focus on recovering degraded amplitude information. In contrast, we employ the phase spectrum to constrain structural consistency during semi-supervised learning. Even though the pseudo-GTs are accessible, using them alone is not optimal. ( Oppenheim and Lim, 1980 ) shows that the phase spectrum is inherently robust to illumination variations and color shifts, making it possible to also use the phase spectrum of the input image to constrain the structure of the output image. Nevertheless, severe weather degradations may also corrupt phase information by obscuring structural details ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Therefore, directly enforcing consistency with the phase spectrum of either the degraded input or pseudo-GT can lead to sub-optimal solutions. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive phase consistency loss that dynamically balances supervision between the degraded input and the teacher-generated pseudo-GT according to degradation severity. Consequently, the model relies more on the input phase for mild degradations while progressively shifting toward the pseudo-GT phase under severe degradations.
blocks.zh: 我们不依靠语言监督,而是利用傅里叶相位谱作为高效的结构前身. 众所周知,傅里叶相位谱主要保存结构和语义信息,而振幅谱主要代表低等外观(Oppenheim等,1979年). 现有的以傅里叶为主的恢复方法(Guo等,2022年)主要侧重于恢复已退化的振幅信息. 相形之下,我们利用相相谱来制约半监督学习过程中的结构一致性. 尽管伪GT是可访问的,但单用它们并不理想. blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose a new mechanism in the family of semi-supervised weather removal methods that identifies and preserves failed teacher predictions in an unreliable database, enabling their use as negative samples for contrastive semi-supervised learning and improving generalization to real-world adverse weather image restoration. • We introduce the Fourier phase spectrum as an efficient structural prior, eliminating the need for computationally expensive and ambiguous text-based supervision. • We propose an adaptive phase consistency loss that automatically adjusts structural supervision according to degradation severity, producing more robust restorations across diverse adverse weather conditions. • The proposed framework establishes new state-of-the-art performance among unified and semi-supervised image restoration methods, outperforming existing approaches on both quantitative and qualitative evaluation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Task-specific Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.1 特定任务图像恢复

blocks.en: Image restoration is a fundamental problem in computer vision, aiming to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Early task-specific methods ( Jiang et al., 2017 ; Ancuti and Ancuți, 2013 ) primarily relied on physical imaging models and handcrafted priors tailored to individual degradation types. With the advent of convolutional neural networks ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) and, more recently, transformer-based architectures have significantly advanced restoration performance across a wide range of tasks. For example, Restormer ( Zamir et al., 2021 ) introduces an efficient multi-scale attention mechanism that achieves an excellent balance between restoration quality and computational efficiency. These transformer-based architectures have been successfully applied to deraining ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , desnowing ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , and dehazing ( Song et al., 2023 ) . Despite their impressive performance, most existing methods remain task-specific and require separate models for different degradation types, leading to increased training, storage, and deployment costs.
blocks.zh: 图像修复是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题,目的是从退化的观测中恢复出高质量的图像. 早期的任务特有方法(Jiang等,2017;Ancuti和Ancuți,2013)主要依靠物理成像模型和根据个体降解类型定制的手工前科. 随着革命神经网络(杨等,2024;杨等,2023)的到来,以及更近的变压器式建筑在一系列广泛任务中显著地提升了修复性能. 例如"再暴"(Zamir等,2021年)引入了高效的多尺度关注机制,在恢复质量和计算效率之间实现了极佳的平衡. 这些以变压器为主的建筑成功被应用到去排水(陈等,2023年),去硝(张等,2022年),去硝(宋等,2023年). 尽管其绩效令人印象深刻,但大多数现有方法仍然是针对具体任务的,需要针对不同降解类型制定单独的模型,从而增加培训、储存和部署费用。

blocks.en: 2.2 All-in-One Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.2 全能图像修复

blocks.en: To mitigate the inefficiency of deploying multiple models for diverse weather degradations, unified image restoration methods have attracted increasing attention ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Valanarasu et al., 2021 ) . While these approaches achieve impressive performance on synthetic benchmarks, they often struggle in real-world scenarios due to the substantial domain gap between synthetic and real-world degradations. To bridge this gap, ( Liu et al., 2025b ) proposed a self-evolving framework that combines physics-driven synthetic data generation with a dual-level reinforcement learning strategy. Meanwhile, ( Tang et al., 2026 ) addressed the problem in an unsupervised setting employing global and local discriminators to enhance image realism while preserving structural consistency. WResVLM ( Xu et al., 2024 ) introduced a semi-supervised framework that leverages both labeled synthetic data and unlabeled real-world data through VLM-based semantic supervision. Although effective, the reliance on large VLMs incurs substantial computational overhead and limits scalability and adaptability to resource-constrained applications. we observe that the Fourier phase spectrum inherently preserves the structural and semantic information of an image while being significantly more computationally efficient than VLM-based representations. Motivated by this observation, we propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that provides explicit semantic guidance for semi-supervised learning

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Framework

blocks.en: Motivated by the observations that existing semi-supervised image restoration methods lack informative negative samples and that VLM-based semantic constraints are computationally expensive, we propose a novel semi-supervised framework that addresses both limitations. Specifically, we incorporate an unreliable image database into the unsupervised learning process to provide challenging negative samples, while replacing conventional VLM-based semantic supervision with a lightweight phase spectrum-based semantic constraint. This design improves both training effectiveness and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 以现有的半监督图像还原方法缺乏信息性负面样本以及基于VLM的语义约束在计算上成本高昂的观察为动机,我们提出一个新的半监督框架来解决这两种限制. 具体地说,我们把不可靠的图像数据库纳入无监督的学习过程,以提供具有挑战性的负面样本,同时用轻量级频谱语义约束取代了以常规VLM为基础的语义监督. 这种设计既提高了培训效力,也提高了计算效率。

blocks.en: 3.2 Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 无监督学习的矛盾学习

blocks.en: Ideally, the teacher network produces higher-quality predictions than the student network and therefore provides reliable supervisory signals for unlabeled data. To improve the quality of pseudo-GTs, other methods ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) retain only reliable teacher outputs, where reliability is assessed using the no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metric. However, this assumption does not always hold in practice. As shown in Fig. 6 , the teacher may still generate unsatisfactory predictions containing severe artifacts, color distortion, or only marginal improvements over the degraded input. Such erroneous outputs are simply discarded in existing methods, leaving their valuable negative information unexplored.
blocks.zh: 理想的情况是,教师网络产生比学生网络更高的质量预测,因此为无标签数据提供可靠的监督信号. 为了提高伪GT的质量,其他方法(黄克华等,2023;许克等,2024)只保留了可靠的教师产出,其可靠性使用无参考图像质量评估(NR-IQA)度量标准进行评估. 然而,这一假设在实践中并不总是有效。 如图6所示,教师可能仍然产生不令人满意的预测,其中含有严重的文物,色彩扭曲,或仅比已退化的输入稍有改进. 这种错误的产出在现行方法中被完全抛弃,使其宝贵的负面信息得不到探讨。

blocks.en: To exploit these failure cases, we introduce an unreliable database that explicitly stores the best historical failure for each unlabeled sample. Instead of treating poor predictions as useless, we regard them as informative negative samples that indicate undesirable restoration outcomes. During training, the student network is encouraged to avoid producing outputs similar to those stored in the unreliable database, while the teacher network inherits this behavior through EMA updates.
blocks.zh: 为了利用这些失败案例,我们引入了一个不可靠的数据库,明确存储每个无标签样本的最佳历史失败. 我们不把差的预测视为无用,而是把它们视为信息丰富的负面样本,表明不良的恢复结果。 在培训期间,鼓励学生网络避免产生类似于不可靠的数据库所存储的产出,而教师网络则通过EMA更新来继承这种行为.

blocks.en: Specifically, we initialize both the reliable database and the unreliable database as empty. For each unlabeled image x i u ∈ D U = { x i u } i = 1 M x_{i}^{u}\in D_{U}=\{x_{i}^{u}\}_{i=1}^{M} , the current teacher prediction is compared with the degraded input, the student prediction, and the historical entries in both databases. If the teacher prediction achieves the highest image quality, it replaces the corresponding entry in the reliable database. Otherwise, if it represents a failed prediction but is of higher quality than the existing entry in the unreliable database, the unreliable database is updated accordingly. The complete updating procedure is summarized in Algo. 1 . Consequently, the reliable database B R = { y ^ i r } i = 1 M B_{R}=\{\hat{y}_{i}^{r}\}_{i=1}^{M} maintains the best pseudo-GT for each unlabeled image, whereas the unreliable database B U = { y ^ i u } i = 1 M B_{U}=\{\hat{y}_{i}^{u}\}_{i=1}^{M} records the strongest failure encountered during training, providing explicit negative supervision that discourages the model from repeating similar restoration errors.

blocks.en: 3.3 Structural Constraint for Unsupervised Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 无监督学习的结构约束

blocks.en: Restoring images degraded by adverse weather requires not only recovering visual fidelity but also preserving the underlying structures obscured by weather-induced artifacts. Semantic supervision is particularly beneficial in semi-supervised learning, where reliable labels are unavailable for real-world data. To exploit semantic information, WResVLM ( Xu et al., 2024 ) employs VLMs to construct a contrastive semantic supervision objective. Although effective, such approaches incur substantial computational overhead and rely on language representations that are inherently ambiguous and weakly aligned with the fine-grained spatial structures required for low-level vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 恢复因恶劣天气而退化的图像不仅需要恢复视觉的忠诚性,而且还需要保留被天气引起的文物所掩盖的基本结构。 语义学监督在半监督学习中特别有益处,因为现实世界的数据没有可靠的标签. 为了利用语义信息,WResVLM(Xu等,2024年)使用VLM来构建一个对比语义监督目标. 虽然这种做法是有效的,但会产生大量的计算间接费用并依赖语言表述,这些表述本身含混不清,而且与低层次愿景任务所需的精细空间结构不太一致。

blocks.en: Instead, we propose a lightweight phase spectrum-based structural constraint. Our design is motivated by two observations. First, previous studies have shown that the Fourier phase spectrum preserves most of the semantic and structural information of an image ( Guo et al., 2022 ) . Second, although the phase spectrum is generally robust to illumination changes and color shifts, severe degradations may still corrupt its structural information ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Consequently, neither the degraded input nor the teacher-generated pseudo-GT should be treated as an absolutely reliable structural reference.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们建议一种基于光谱的轻量级结构限制。 我们的设计受到两个观察的推动。 首先,先前的研究表明,傅里叶相位谱保存了图像的大部分语义和结构信息(郭等,2022. 第二,虽然相位谱对光照变化和色相变化一般都很强,但严重的退化仍会破坏其结构信息(Liu等人,2025a.)。 因此,既不应将退化的投入,也不应将教师产生的伪GT视为绝对可靠的结构参考。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we construct an adaptive phase consistency loss by combining the phase spectrum of the degraded input and the reliable pseudo-GT according to their estimated image qualities. Specifically, the student prediction is encouraged to align its phase spectrum with this adaptive reference through the following phase consistency loss L phase = ∑ i = 1 M w i ​ d og + ( 1 − w i ) ​ d oi , L_{\text{phase}}=\sum_{i=1}^{M}w_{i}d_{\text{og}}+(1-w_{i})d_{\text{oi}}\>, (6) where P ⁡ ( ⋅ ) P(\cdot) denotes the Fourier phase spectrum, d og = | P ⁡ ( y i s ) − P ⁡ ( y ^ i r ) | d_{\text{og}}=|P(y^{s}_{i})-P(\hat{y}^{r}_{i})| and d oi = | P ⁡ ( y i s ) − P ⁡ ( x i u ) | d_{\text{oi}}=|P(y^{s}_{i})-P(x^{u}_{i})| are L1 distance. w i = z i r z i x + z i r , w_{i}=\frac{z^{r}_{i}}{z^{x}_{i}+z^{r}_{i}}\>, (7) where z i r = sco ​ ( y ^ i r ) z^{r}_{i}=\text{sco}(\hat{y}_{i}^{r}) and z i x = sco ​ ( x i u ) z^{x}_{i}=\text{sco}(x_{i}^{u}) denote the NR-IQA scores of the reliable pseudo-GT and degraded input, respectively. Intuitively, severe degradations result in a significantly lower quality score for the input image than for the pseudo-GT, yielding a larger w i w_{i} . In this case, the structural constraint relies more heavily on the reliable pseudo-GT. Conversely, when the degradation is mild, the degraded input already retains sufficient structural information, causing w i w_{i} to decrease and the supervision to place greater emphasis on the input image. This adaptive strategy enables the model to exploit the most reliable structural information available under varying degradation levels while avoiding excessive dependence on either source alone.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: In this section, we present the experimental results of our method. We train our method in two settings: all-in-one and single-task, with the same setup. Our semi-supervised learning framework is easily compatible with various image restoration networks. Following ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , we opt for MSBDN ( Dong et al., 2020a ) as our backbone due to its balanced performance and rapid inference speed in our main study. For the NR-IQA method, we incorporate the SOTA RALI score ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Each batch comprises 8 8 labeled and 8 8 unlabeled images, and the number of epochs is set to 200 200 . During training, we used the Adam optimizer ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 and the learning rate 2 ​ e − 5 2e-5 . All training was conducted on 2 × H ​ 100 2\times H100 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍我们方法的实验结果。 我们用两种设置来训练我们的方法:全程和单任务,设置相同. 我们的半监督学习框架很容易与各种图像恢复网络相兼容。 随后(徐等,2024年),我们选择了MSBDN(董等,2020a)作为我们的骨干,因为其性能平衡,在主要研究中推论速度快. 对于NR-IQA方法,我们纳入SOTA RALI分数(赵等,2026. 每批包含8个标有标签的图像和8个未标有标签的图像,并设定为200个纪元. 在训练期间,我们使用了亚当优化器(Kingma和Ba,2014年),其中β 1 = 0.9\β1}=0.9和β 2 = 0.999\β2}=0.999,学习率为2 e − 5 2e 5. 所有培训都是在2×H 100 2\times H100上进行的。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: Following previous works ( Valanarasu et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , we adopt the all-weather dataset ( Valanarasu et al., 2021 ) as labeled dataset. Meanwhile, we leverage the unlabeled real-world adverse weather images for unsupervised learning. To achieve this, we utilize the real hazy image in URHI ( Li et al., 2017b ) , the real rainy image in the SPA+ test set ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , and the real snowy image from the RealSnow dataset ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) . Following ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , we employ real adverse weather image datasets for qualitative and quantitative evaluation for the unified model, including RTTS ( Li et al., 2017b ) , DDN-SIRR ( Wei et al., 2019 ) , and Real3000 ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , and Snow100k Realistic ( Liu et al., 2017 ) . As ground truth is not available, we employ widely used non-reference metrics LIQE ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) and CLIP-IQA ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 继前作(Valanarasu等,2021;Sun等,2024;Wang等,2025a)后,我们采用全天候数据集(Valanarasu等,2021)作为标签数据集. 同时,我们利用无标签的真实世界的不良天气图像进行无监督的学习。 为了实现这一目标,我们利用了URHI(Li等,2017b)中真实的模糊图像,SPA+测试集中真实的雨色图像(Zhu等,2023),以及RealSnow数据集中真实的雪色图像(Zhu等,2023). 跟踪 (徐等,2024),我们采用真实恶劣天气影像数据集对统一模型进行定性和定量评价,包括RTTS(李等,2017b),DDN-SIRR(魏等,2019),Real3000(刘等,2021),Snow100k Realistic(刘等,2017. 由于没有地面真相,我们采用了广泛使用的非参考指标LIQE(张等,2023年)和CLIP-IQA(王等,2023年).

The results are reported in PSNR and SSIM.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: The results of competing methods are obtained either by directly citing the reported results from the original papers, reproducing the results using the authors’ publicly released models, or retraining the models using their official implementations.
blocks.zh: 竞争方法的结果要么直接取自原始文件所报告的结果,要么利用作者公开发布的模型复制结果,要么利用官方执行对模型进行再培训。

blocks.en: We compare the proposed method with recent state-of-the-art all-in-one image restoration models, including Restormer ( Zamir et al., 2021 ) , TransWeather ( Valanarasu et al., 2021 ) , TKL ( Chen et al., 2022b ) , WeatherDiffusion ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , WGWS-Net ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , MWDT ( Patil et al., 2023 ) , PromptIR ( Potlapalli et al., 2023 ) , DA-CLIP ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , WResVLM ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , Histoformer ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , MODEM ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and HOGformer ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . The quantitative comparisons are presented in Tab. 1 . Our method achieves the best overall performance, surpassing the second-best method by 0.142 in LIQE and 0.021 in CLIP-IQA. Moreover, within the family of semi-supervised methods, our approach consistently outperforms WResVLM across all evaluated weather restoration tasks. Despite these improvements, our method remains computationally efficient. Compared with MODEM, it achieves comparable model complexity with the same number of parameters while requiring only approximately one-third of the computational cost (GFLOPs).

blocks.en: To further evaluate the generalization ability of the proposed framework, we also compare it with representative single-task image restoration methods, including UMR ( Yasarla and Patel, 2019 ) , SIRR ( Wei et al., 2019 ) , MSPFN ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) , DehazeNet ( Cai et al., 2016 ) , MSCNN ( Ren et al., 2016 ) , AODNet ( Li et al., 2017a ) , EPDN ( Qu et al., 2019 ) , FDGAN ( Dong et al., 2020b ) , LPNet ( Gao et al., 2019 ) , AirNet ( Li et al., 2022 ) , Restormer ( Zamir et al., 2021 ) , PromptIR ( Potlapalli et al., 2023 ) , SwinIR ( Liang et al., 2021 ) , NAFNet ( Chen et al., 2022a ) , UniRestorer ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and DFPIR ( Tian et al., 2025a ) . The results are summarized in Tab. 2 . Our method achieves the highest PSNR on the desnowing task, outperforming UniRestorer by at least 0.13 dB. blocks.en: We qualitatively compare our method with state-of-the-art image restoration approaches on challenging real-world adverse weather images. The visual comparisons are presented in Fig. 2 . As can be observed, most competing methods struggle to simultaneously remove rain, haze, and snow artifacts, often leaving noticeable degradations or introducing undesirable visual distortions. In particular, PromptIR ( Potlapalli et al., 2023 ) and TKL ( Chen et al., 2022b ) partially suppress haze but tend to produce texture distortions and over-smoothed details. In contrast, our method consistently restores clearer scene structures while preserving natural textures, resulting in superior visual quality with enhanced clarity, contrast, and overall perceptual realism. Moreover, our approach effectively removes residual haze commonly present in rainy and snowy scenes, leading to significantly improved visibility.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented an unreliable-aware semi-supervised learning framework for real-world adverse weather image restoration. The proposed framework combines an unreliable bank for exploiting failed pseudo-GTs as hard negative samples with an adaptive phase consistency loss that replaces expensive vision-language model-based semantic supervision. Together, these components effectively reduce confirmation bias while providing efficient structural guidance during training. Future work will investigate extending the implementation.
blocks.zh: 本文为真实世界恶劣天气图像修复提出了不可靠的半监督学习框架. 拟议的框架将一个不可靠的银行合并起来,将失败的伪GT用作硬负性样品,与适应相统一性损失,取代了昂贵的以视觉语言模型为基础的语义监督. 这些组成部分共同有效减少确认偏差,同时在培训期间提供有效的结构指导。 今后的工作将研究扩大执行工作。

blocks.en: Tab. 11 shows that our method achieves the strongest overall performance across all evaluation metrics. It improves the overall AP to 35.3, outperforming the best baseline, PromptIR Potlapalli et al. (2023) , by 4.1 points. Similar gains are observed at different IoU thresholds, reaching 38.7 AP 50 and 36.6 AP 75 , which indicates improvements in both detection accuracy and localization quality. For object-scale evaluation, our method obtains the highest performance on small (44.4) and large (35.3) objects, while matching the best result on medium-sized objects (29.9). These results demonstrate that the proposed method provides consistent improvements across different IoU criteria and object scales.

blocks.en: To further prove the effectiveness of our all-in-one model, we have conducted a comparison with HOGformer ( Wu et al., 2026 ) in two different no-reference metrics, Q-Align ( Wu et al., 2023 ) and MUSIQ ( Ke et al., 2021 ) . The results, which are reported in Tab. 12 , indicate that our method achieves the best average performance across both perceptual quality metrics, improving Q-Align from 2.6725 to 2.6764 and MUSIQ from 53.114 to 53.274. In particular, our method consistently outperforms HOGFormer on both metrics for rain degradation, while also providing clear improvements for haze restoration. For snow degradation, HOGFormer performs better, suggesting that our method may be less effective for this specific corruption type. Nevertheless, the higher overall average indicates that our approach provides more balanced restoration quality across different degradation conditions. We use the same dataset as the main paper.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步证明我们全能模式的有效性,我们用Q-Align(Wu等,2023年)和MUSIQ(Ke等,2021年)两个不同的无参考度量衡与HOGFOR(Wu等,2026年)进行了比较. 结果在Tab中报告。 12,表示我们的方法在感官质量衡量标准上都实现了最佳平均性能,使Q-Align从2.6725提高到2.6764,MUSIQ从 53.114提高到 53.274. 特别是,我们的方法在雨量退化的两种度量标准上都一直优于HOGFORmer,同时也为烟雾修复提供了明显的改进. 对于降雪,HOGFORmer表现更好,说明我们的方法对于这种特定的腐败类型可能不太有效. 然而,总体平均值较高表明,我们的做法在不同退化条件下提供了更平衡的恢复质量。 我们使用与主纸相同的数据集.
